messages:
Maya Patel: quick thought: what if we make match->score a push pattern for hot tenants? match streams candidates to scorer for selected tenant sessions to avoid sync RPCs. reduces p99 but increases complexity.
Ravi Singh: push for hot tenants sounds interesting. how do we control memory bloat on scorer side? need eviction by session TTL or LRU.
Liam O'Connor: agree. also need backpressure signals from scorer to match to avoid overload. implement via token-bucket or simple per-host capacity gauge.
Evelyn Park: operationally, streaming increases connections and cert churn. maybe limit to Dedicated and high-tier tenants only.
Maya Patel: good call. fallback to pull model for others. we can parameterize per-tenant route.admission.mode = stream|pull.
Ravi Singh: telemetry note: streamed mode must still produce deterministic labels. don't add free-form metadata per-message.
Liam O'Connor: include a lightweight sequence number in stream to handle re-order and idempotency.
Evelyn Park: security: streamed session auth must rotate tokens and have short TTLs. ops team will want a rotation window.
Maya Patel: action items: (1) add stream mode to proto as opt-in, (2) design backpressure signals and session eviction rules, (3) limit rollout to Dedicated high-tier tenants first.
ops-bot: Deploybot: created ticket PD-4012 "streaming-match-to-scorer" and assigned to Maya.
Maya Patel: aiming for a short doc by Tuesday. will dump links here. :thumbsup:
